about: Pairs of a proposed claim and an existing fact. Expected outcomes for the brain_neighbour gate. Written 2026-09-25 as a starting set.

state.new_claim: Acme Corp, founded in 2019, is based in Leeds.
state.existing_fact: Acme Corp was founded in 2019 in Leeds.

state.new_claim: The head office of Acme Corp is in Leeds.
state.existing_fact: Acme Corp is headquartered in Leeds.

state.new_claim: Acme Corp makes small wind turbines.
state.existing_fact: Acme Corp was founded in 2019 in Leeds.

state.new_claim: Acme Corp opened an office in Dublin in 2025.
state.existing_fact: Acme Corp is headquartered in Leeds.

cases.note: A second office does not contradict the headquarters.

state.existing_fact: Acme Corp was founded in 2019 in Leeds.

state.new_claim: Acme Corp was founded in Manchester.
state.existing_fact: Acme Corp was founded in Leeds.

cases.note: A founding place does not change over time, so this is a contradiction, not an update.

state.new_claim: Jane Smith is now chief executive of Acme Corp.
state.existing_fact: Jane Smith is chief technology officer of Acme Corp.

state.new_claim: The Breeze 2 kW turbine now costs 4,500 pounds.
state.existing_fact: The Breeze 2 kW turbine costs 4,200 pounds.

state.new_claim: Acme Corp was not founded anywhere other than Leeds.
state.existing_fact: Acme Corp was founded in Leeds.

state.new_claim: Acme Corp was founded in the year before 2020.
Acme Corp's staff is twice the 20 people it had in 2023.

cases.note: Also reads as an update over time; a person may prefer 'related'.
